alternative: The measured slots40 improvement removes most readiness blocking and serial compute or other work dominates the residual decode.
intervention: Enable the already validated C123 diagnostic trace in the same instrumented backend source with slots40, without changing routing, weights or workload.
workload: C129 official two-turn assistant-history nominal153 fixture; trace only second request

neutrality_gate: Official input IDs and complete response text, output token counts and finish reasons must match all three C129 slots40 candidate arms. Same-binary trace-off latency is a separate follow-on if timing overhead matters to a causal estimate.
decision: If readiness waits remain material, identify whether CPU or GPU dominates and choose one bounded movement or residency test only with a plausible critical-path saving.
